CREATE VIEW high_fidelity_meshes AS
SELECT 
    sm.facetregistry AS mesh_id,
    s.zoneregistry AS site_reference,
    e.equipform AS equipment,
    sm.facetverts AS facet_vert_count,
    sm.facetfaces AS face_count,
    sm.facetresmm AS resolution,
    sm.geomdeltamm AS accuracy,
    ROUND(CAST((sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * sm.facetresmm::numeric * sm.facetresmm::numeric) * 1000.0, 4) AS complexity_value
FROM scanmesh sm
JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
JOIN equipment e ON sm.equipref = e.equipregistry

    (sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * sm.facetresmm::numeric * sm.facetresmm::numeric) * 1000.0) > 5.0
    AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0
    AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5;
